questions.subject: m1
questions.question: The length of each identical rod is recorded as $2.4\,\mathrm{m}$, correct to the nearest $0.1\,\mathrm{m}$. What is the smallest number of rods guaranteed to have a combined length greater than $12\,\mathrm{m}$?

questions.subject: phys
questions.question: A wave enters a second medium at an angle to the normal. Its speed decreases from $v$ to $3v/4$. Which statement is correct?
choices: Its frequency and wavelength both decrease; it bends towards the normal.
Its frequency is unchanged, its wavelength becomes $3/4$ of its original value, and it bends towards the normal.
Its frequency is unchanged, its wavelength becomes $4/3$ of its original value, and it bends away from the normal.
Its frequency decreases, its wavelength is unchanged, and it bends away from the normal.

questions.subject: m2
questions.question:
The equation
$$x^2-kx+9=0$$
has two distinct positive real roots. Which condition must $k$ satisfy?

questions.subject: phys
questions.question:
An $80\,\mathrm{W}$ heater is $75\%$ efficient. It is used to melt $0.12\,\mathrm{kg}$ of a substance already at its melting temperature. The substance has specific latent heat of fusion
$$2.0\times10^5\,\mathrm{J\,kg^{-1}}.$$
How long does melting take?

questions.subject: m2
questions.question:
A function $f$ has exactly two roots, $-2$ and $3$. What is the sum of all real solutions of
$$f(2x-1)=0?$$

questions.subject: phys
questions.question:
An object accelerates uniformly from speed $u$ to $3u$ over distance $s$. It then decelerates uniformly to rest over a further distance $s$. What is
$$\frac{\text{magnitude of the deceleration}}{\text{initial acceleration}}?$$

questions.subject: m1
questions.question:
A histogram has the following bars:
$$\begin{array}{c|c}\text{Class interval}&\text{Frequency density}\\ \hline 0\leq x<10&2\\10\leq x<15&5\\15\leq x<30&1\end{array}$$
What fraction of the observations satisfy $x\geq15$?

questions.subject: phys
questions.question: A horizontal force $F$ gives an object of mass $m$ acceleration $a$ on a smooth surface. The same force is then applied to an object of mass $3m$, but a frictional force $F/4$ opposes the motion. What is the second object's acceleration?

questions.subject: m2
questions.question: A sector has area $12\pi\,\mathrm{cm^2}$ and arc length $4\pi\,\mathrm{cm}$. What is its perimeter?

questions.subject: phys
questions.question: An ultrasound pulse has frequency $2.0\,\mathrm{MHz}$. It returns to its source $40\,\mathrm{\mu s}$ after being emitted. How many wavelengths fit into the pulse's total out-and-back path?

questions.subject: m2
questions.question:
In an arithmetic sequence,
$$u_4+u_{10}=30.$$
What is the sum of the first $13$ terms?

questions.subject: phys
questions.question: A nuclide is represented by ${}^{A}_{Z}X$. It emits one alpha particle followed by two beta-minus particles. What are the mass number and atomic number of the final nuclide?

questions.subject: m2
questions.question: The sum of the first $12$ terms of an arithmetic sequence is $30$. The sum of the next $12$ terms is $-6$. What is the sum of the first $60$ terms?

questions.subject: phys
questions.question: A small object of mass $m$, travelling at speed $v$, collides directly with a stationary block of mass $3m$ and becomes embedded in it. The combined object subsequently climbs a smooth ramp. What maximum vertical height does it reach?

questions.subject: m2
questions.question:
For every non-zero real $x$, a function $f$ satisfies
$$f(x)+2f\left(\frac1x\right)=5x+\frac1x.$$
What is $f(2)$?

questions.subject: m1
questions.question:
From the origin $O$, two non-parallel position vectors locate points $A$ and $B$. Point $P$ lies on $OA$ and point $Q$ lies on $OB$, with
$$OP:PA=2:1,\qquad OQ:QB=1:2.$$
The lines $PQ$ and $AB$ meet at $R$. What is $AR:RB$?

questions.subject: m2
questions.question:
For a non-zero real constant $a$, the graph
$$y=x^2+ax$$
and the $x$-axis enclose a region of area $9/2$. What is $|a|$?

questions.subject: phys
questions.question:
A small mass $m$ rests on top of a vertical spring but is not attached to it. The spring, of stiffness $k$, is initially compressed by distance $x$, and the mass is released from rest. There are no energy losses, and
$$kx=3mg.$$
What is the mass's maximum height above its initial position?
